baseline.reason: All three sanitizer builds succeeded and were tested with the identical payload and command. post_intro aborted with exit 134 and ASan reported a heap-buffer-overflow, READ of size 30 in memcpy called by zipfileGetEntry. But pre_intro also aborted with exit 134 with the same ASan heap-buffer-overflow at the same zipfileGetEntry memcpy, so intro commit d05bf5aedff9 did not introduce the labelled vulnerability: pre_intro had no blob bounds guard, while post_intro added an insufficient guard using
